notes: Phase E, transport optimism moved into PlaybackStore — steps 1-4 of 5, deliberately stopping short of deletion. SonosZone.playingUntil recorded 'the app just issued a command to this zone', which is the same fact PlaybackDeclaration already holds as declaredAt — one truth in two places, and it had already drifted: 5s in persistStationPlay, 6s in the other five call sites, against a declarationGrace of 5, chosen by nobody. It could not simply fold into the declaration because two of the six setters make no content claim at all: pausing changes transport only, and grouping is topology. So the store gains TransportIntent alongside PlaybackDeclaration, and the reducer applies optimism to isPlaying the same way it already does to content. CORRECTED ON THE WAY THROUGH: togglePlayPause only set the grace window on idle -> playing, so a pause the user issued had no protection and could be reverted by the next poll; it now declares in both directions. BOTH MECHANISMS ARE LIVE — playingUntil is untouched and still consulted in fetchTransportStates — so behaviour is unchanged and a regression is structurally impossible until step 5 removes the field. Built test-first: five reducer tests written before the wiring, run once to confirm they failed for the right reasons (3 red, 2 green, exactly as predicted), then wired. 22 reducer tests green.
